name: Looped mdlARC d384 ×6 + ReARC, scale augmentation, deterministic filters, likelihood ranking
summary: d384 ×6 looped transformer trained on ARC-AGI, ConceptARC and up to 1,000 ReARC examples per ARC-AGI-1 training task, with scale augmentation; decoded with scale views, deterministic filters and likelihood ranking.
declared_components: ReARC data: up to 1,000 pre-generated examples per ARC-AGI-1 training task (re-arc e5b7f1d), 129 known-bad pairs removed
Scale augmentation: integer block upscaling of every grid in a training sequence, and scale views at decode
Deterministic filters (transductARC's "symbolic guards"): task-agnostic checks that reject candidates whose colours or shape contradict the demos
